items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Ernest Kelly, Joe Johnson, Mud Carey, Tate Chambers, sometimes Bunk Johnson, the trumpet.

ctx.x: No. Mud Carey would play him and Mud Carey and Joe Johnson, the trumpet player, you know. Joe Johnson, Ernest Kelly on trombone. But they could read. See, little Joe Johnson could read. Ernest Kelly too. Ernest Kelly, Joe Johnson, Mud Carey, Tate Chambers, sometimes Bunk Johnson, the trumpet.
You remember Bunk back then, right?
